text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have raised concerns about crowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting or lacking educational value, with some visitors feeling it did not honor Theodore Roosevelt’s legacy. A few visitors also noted that the content did not provide enough historical depth or context about Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Positive comments frequently mentioned the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but the balance between technology and substantive interpretation appears to need attention.

While interactive exhibits were frequently mentioned and generally well received, there were concerns that some technology elements did not add meaningful value. Other topics raised included architecture, food and beverage options, and parking, but these were less commonly noted. Overall, the average rating remains high, though attention to visitor flow and exhibit content could improve the experience.
